subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` mode for stranded `message_tool_only` finals, switch to a default recovery/diagnostic policy like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 after conflicts are resolved, or keep current diagnostics-only behavior?
rationale: The code path changes a documented privacy/message-delivery contract and adds a new global config surface, so automation cannot choose the product policy even though the implementation is reviewable.

options.title: Approve opt-in recovery after proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate path, but require maintainer policy signoff and redacted external-channel proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer default recovery successor
options.body: Pause or close this PR only after the successor is conflict-free and maintainer-approved as the canonical default-recovery policy.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only behavior
options.body: Reject recovery and keep current main's warning-only behavior, documenting that operators should use automatic visible replies or stronger tool-calling models.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in recovery after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the candidate path, but require maintainer policy signoff and redacted external-channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior diagnostics PR was merged with a maintainer rewrite signal from this handle, making it the clearest available owner for the policy boundary.
